metadata.name: Synthetic 50-Item E-Commerce Product Catalog
metadata.description: 50 fictional products with variants, option matrices, per-variant prices and stock, availability states, ratings and packed dimensions, plus a flat one-row-per-variant view for CSV export. Built for database seeding, headless storefronts, search indexing and checkout tests.

conventions.prices: Decimal numbers with at most 2 decimal places. Store them as integer cents or DECIMAL(10,2), not floating point.
conventions.product_price: Lowest variant price (the 'from' price). compare_at_price is the matching original price, or null when not on sale.
conventions.inventory_quantity: Sum of variant stock. in_stock is true when inventory_quantity is greater than 0.
conventions.availability: Google Merchant Center values: in_stock, out_of_stock, preorder, backorder.
conventions.dimensions: Packed (shipping box) weight and dimensions, shared by all variants of a product.
conventions.uuid: RFC 9562 UUIDv7. The timestamp is created_at; the random bits are derived from the SKU, so values stay the same across releases.
conventions.sku: Product sku is the parent SKU (Merchant Center item_group_id). Variant SKUs are unique; a single-variant product uses its parent SKU for its one variant.
conventions.variant_rows: One flat row per variant with only text, number or null values, ready for a JSON to CSV converter.
